retrievalProfile.description: A layered collage style featuring vertical torn paper edges, high-contrast color blocking, and heavy geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition defined by vertical strips of torn paper with visible white deckle edges, dividing the frame into distinct color zones of salmon, grey, and black, topped with heavy block lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical torn edges create a rhythmic division of the canvas
Heavy blue typography overlaps the salmon and black background zones
Horizontal grey bars provide a geometric counterpoint to vertical rips
High contrast between the organic paper edges and rigid font geometry
coreInvariants: Visible white fibrous texture along the torn paper edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large display text occupies the top right quadrant; vertical paper strips dominate the left third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, blue, stacked block text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the vertical rips downward, then move right to the bold text and horizontal bars.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The central salmon-colored paper strip acts as the primary field for secondary information.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted sky blue for primary typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated mid-tones (salmon, grey, blue) contrasted against a high-value black.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars in 'E' are nearly touching
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair ultra-bold display headers with condensed, high-contrast serif sub-captions.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and blocky nature of the display text.
Captures the 80s geometric weight and character.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of vertical torn paper strips in salmon, grey, and black. Ensure the torn edges show white fibrous texture. Add horizontal grey bars in the lower right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the primary text in an ultra-bold blue geometric sans-serif, stacked in the top right. Add secondary text in a condensed serif font above the horizontal bars.

verificationChecks: Are the paper edges visibly torn with white texture?
Is the blue text ultra-heavy and stacked?
Is the color palette limited to salmon, grey, black, and blue?

adjustableVariables: Width of the torn paper strips
Color of the primary display text
mustRedesign: Do not replicate specific artist names
postGenerationChecks: Check for white deckle edges on all rips
Verify text overlaps the color boundary
Ensure horizontal bars are perfectly straight
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Torn Strips + Ultra-Bold Stacked Sans + Geometric Accents
